resources.string: Make scanned pages searchable. Runs on this device. English is included; other languages can be added from a file.
Reads the text on scanned pages and adds it as an invisible layer, so the saved copy can be searched and its text selected. Pages look exactly the same. Everything happens on this device.
Skip pages that already have text
Expect a few seconds per page, more with several languages. Save a copy afterwards to keep the text layer.
Add a language from a file

Other languages are Tesseract language files with names like “deu.traineddata” (the “tessdata_fast” set is small and works well). Loose Leaf has no network access, so download the file with a browser or copy it from a computer, then add it here. Text in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters can be saved; other scripts are not supported yet.
That is not a language file. Its name must end in “.traineddata”, like “deu.traineddata”.
That file could not be read.
The text recognition engine could not use that file.
